reply_text:
I replied to Dana in their DM. On Oct 14, Dana told me their escalation contact at Quarrendon Freight Lines for the Larchmont rollout is Soren Tolland, so that's who I said to call. I don't have a phone number or email for Soren on file, so Dana will need their own contact details. I also offered to help find someone else if today's problem isn't about Larchmont.

I used only what Dana told me in their own DM. The contacts other members saved for their rollouts stayed out of it.

One mistake: my message called Soren "he," but no one has said what Soren's pronouns are, and I should have used "they." The message is already posted, and I didn't send a correction.
